criterion: How the node picks the active tip.
The dedicated maximum-block-size consensus rule (ignoring the generic serialisation ceiling).
Status of the broad opcode set v0.1 shipped and 2010 disabled (OP_CAT, OP_MUL, bitwise, etc.).
The maximum width of a numeric script operand.
The maximum size of a single stack element.
Whether strict-DER signature encoding is enforced.
Whether outputs/sums are bounded by a MoneyRange invariant (vs only nValue < 0).
Whether a Schnorr scheme is available in consensus in addition to ECDSA.
Whether the P2SH special-case output template is a consensus rule.
Whether witness data is segregated with a separate commitment (BIP141).
Whether Taproot (BIP341 key/script-path) outputs are a consensus rule.
Whether CLTV/CSV-style timelock opcodes are active (v0.1 leaves the slots as NOPs).
The retarget algorithm governing proof-of-work difficulty, INCLUDING any additional real-time target a block must also satisfy to be accepted.
Whether a fork-id is mixed into the signature hash.
Whether non-coinbase transactions must follow a canonical order (CTOR) vs topological.
The genesis-era block subsidy (coins per block before the first halving).
The target mean time between blocks.
Whether the block height must appear in the coinbase input (BIP34).
The hash function a valid block header must satisfy the target under.
